difficulty_definitions.easy: Answer lives in a single passage of a single document; keyword-matchable.
difficulty_definitions.medium: 2-3 passages; one hop across sections or one cross-document reference; semantic retrieval matters.
difficulty_definitions.hard: 3+ passages spanning multiple documents or doc types; multi-hop or a cross-cutting concern.

rationale: fact_lookup skews easy/medium: it is the class where precise chunking + reranking and the local-first answer have the strongest claim (mirrors LOCATE in the code set).
traceability has no 'easy' tier: a single-document lookup is not a trace. It skews hard because it is multi-hop across the SDLC chain and is the class flat RAG cannot answer.
synthesis skews medium/hard: aggregation/comparison over many documents; the 2 'easy' records are small single-collection summaries.
doc-type coverage is enforced as a secondary constraint instead of a full doc_type x query_type x difficulty cross-product (which would be 117 cells for a 60-record bootstrap).
notes: SPEC ONLY. No prose corpus is present in this repository yet, so no records are generated and nothing here runs in CI.
Mirrors tests/eval/pipeline/phase1_plan.json (the code eval plan). Reuses the three-role Author/Oracle/Adversary pipeline; the Oracle reads documents instead of code.
